name: 30002 · Avondale Est, GA
findings: ZIP 30002 (Avondale Est) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30002 (Avondale Est) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 30002 (Avondale Est) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
